name: io.github.szl-holdings/hatun-mcp
title: Hatun MCP - Governed Agent Gateway
description: Governed MCP gateway: policy gate on every tool call, hash-chained DSSE receipt on every result.

environmentVariables.name: HATUN_MCP_DISABLE_DYNAMIC
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to skip live organ discovery at startup (hermetic local mode; 25 static tools).

environmentVariables.name: HATUN_MCP_SIGNING_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PEM contents of the ECDSA-P256 DSSE signing key. If absent, receipts are emitted UNSIGNED and say so.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.evidence: Image is SLSA-provenance attested at build; the registry entry claims only what the OCI manifest and this repository show.
